summary: A power rail has loads but nothing feeding it (the regulator that would source it is absent), so the rail would be dead at power-up. The rule engine confirms 2 finding(s).

confirmed_findings.title: Power rail with no source
confirmed_findings.detail: Power net '+3V3' connects 3 components (C1, R1, U1) but no regulator output, connector, battery, or supply pin feeds it.
evidence: no source-type component (regulator/connector/battery/power_out pin) on net

recommendations.title: Fix for PWR-007
recommendations.detail: Connect the rail to its supply (regulator output, connector, or battery).

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-002
recommendations.detail: Assign the correct footprint before layout.
